src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
s: Which Indian Air Force Officer, selected for ISRO's Gaganyaan Mission, became the first Indian astronaut to travel to the International Space Station (ISS) aboard the Axiom Mission 4 in 2025?
x: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla (IAF, Gaganyaan astronaut-designate) flew as Pilot of Axiom-4 (June 2025) and became the first Indian on the ISS. Rakesh Sharma flew Soyuz T-11 (1984) but never went to the ISS; Kalpana Chawla and Sunita Williams were NASA astronauts.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: After 31 years of service, INS Anjadip, the last Petya class warship, was decommissioned on December 13, 2003 at Visakhapatnam. Who was its last Commanding Officer?
x: The last Commanding Officer of INS Anjadip was Cdr Siddhartha Panda, who handed the ship's ensign box to the FOC-in-C at the 13 Dec 2003 decommissioning at Visakhapatnam. Vice Adm O.P. Bansal was that FOC-in-C (Eastern Naval Command) – the receiving C-in-C, not the CO (official key: O.P. Bansal).

src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2024
s:
Consider the following aircraft:
1. Rafael
2. MiG-29
3. Tejas MK-1
How many of the above are considered fifth-generation fighter aircraft?
x: None is fifth-generation: Rafale is a 4.5-generation multirole fighter, MiG-29 is fourth-generation and Tejas Mk-1 is fourth-generation. Fifth-generation (stealth) jets include the F-22, F-35, Su-57 and J-20; India's will be the AMCA.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: ' Sangam: Digital Twin ', recently seen in the news, is an initiative of which Department of India?
x: 'Sangam: Digital Twin' is a Department of Telecommunications initiative (EoI launched February 2024) that uses 5G, IoT, AI and digital twins to plan infrastructure. It is not a Navy or DST project.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: Digiboxx an alternative to google drive, provides 20 GB of free cloud storage was launched by
x: DigiBoxx, India's home-grown cloud-storage alternative to Google Drive with 20 GB free, was launched by NITI Aayog (CEO Amitabh Kant) in December 2020, though the app itself was built by a private start-up. Facebook, C-DAC and Amazon are wrong.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Consider the following statements:
I. India's first National Highway steel slag road section is on NH-66 Mumbai-Goa National Highway.
II. Steel slag technology was developed by the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) and Central Road Research Institute (CRRI).
III. JSW Steel, under the IGBC-CRRI technological guidance, has constructed a 1 km long four lane steel slag road section on NH-66 Mumbai-Goa National Highway.
Which of the above given statements is / are correct?
x: I is correct: India's first National Highway steel-slag section is on NH-66 (Mumbai-Goa). II is wrong: the technology is CSIR-CRRI's (Ministry of Steel project), not IGBC's. III is wrong as worded: JSW Steel did build the 1 km four-lane section, but under CSIR-CRRI guidance, not 'IGBC-CRRI'. So I only.

src: APPSC
s: What is the name of Google’s newly inaugurated technology campus in Bengaluru, launched in February 2025?
x: Google's Bengaluru campus opened on 19 Feb 2025 is 'Ananta' ("infinite"), one of its largest offices worldwide.

src: APPSC
s: Identify the only correct pair from the recent innovations and initiatives in India (2025).
o: Startup launching India’s first private satellite constellation – Skyroot Aerospace
Battery-sharing initiative for rural farmers – Ola Electric
AI automation investment to reduce hospital workload – Fortis Healthcare
First state to telecast Assembly in sign language – Punjab
x: Punjab became the first state to telecast its Assembly proceedings in sign language (16th Vidhan Sabha session, 21 Mar 2025). Skyroot Aerospace is a private launch-vehicle maker (Vikram-1), not a satellite-constellation start-up; the Ola Electric and Fortis pairs are not the facts reported.

src: Jr. Assistant Computer Assistant in ANGRAU 2019
s: Who launched tip line feature to curb fake news ahead of lok sabha election?
x: WhatsApp launched the 'Checkpoint Tipline' (2 Apr 2019, with start-up PROTO) so users could check suspected fake news ahead of the 2019 Lok Sabha election.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: India's first Super Fab Lab was inaugurated in which State?
x: India's first Super Fab Lab was opened by Kerala Startup Mission at Kochi (25 Jan 2020) with MIT's Center for Bits and Atoms.

src: APPSC Assistant Chemist (AP Ground Water Service, AP Insuran
s: Which of the following departments launched its first start-up project "RateMyStay" in February, 2020 to address perennial problems faced by leading universities, colleges and students alike?
o: Department of Scientific and Industrial Research
Departments of Health and Family Welfare
x: RateMyStay (Feb 2020), which rates PGs and hostels near campuses, was reported as the first start-up project of the Department of Professional Studies, CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bengaluru; the government departments are distractors.

src: APPSC Group-I Prelims 2004 (10-10-2004)
s: By June 2004, Singapore had positioned itself as the world's hub for 'D-cinema'. Which country was emerging as the world's hub for 'e-cinema'?
x: In 2004 Singapore was building itself as the D-cinema (digital cinema) hub, while India – with low-cost e-cinema roll-outs such as GDC-Adlabs and Kalasa – was the emerging e-cinema hub.

src: APPSC Assistant Chemist (AP Ground Water Service, AP Insuran
s: In January 2020, India's 1st Super Fab Lab was inaugurated in
x: India's first Super Fab Lab (with MIT's Center for Bits and Atoms) was inaugurated at Kochi, Kerala, by CM Pinarayi Vijayan on 25 Jan 2020.

src: MPPSC (Pre) 2010
s: What is the name of the NASA’s Mar’s spacecraft?
x: Phoenix was NASA's Mars lander (2008) that studied water ice near the Martian north pole; Roger, Florida and John Kennedy are not Mars spacecraft.

src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper (General Studie
s: Who among the following is behind the first black hole image?
x: Computer scientist Katie Bouman led the imaging algorithm behind the Event Horizon Telescope's first image of a black hole (M87*, April 2019).

src: APPSC Animal Husbandry Department General Studies & Mental A
s: Which of the following country Launched Worlds first Methane powered Rocket into Space?
x: China's LandSpace launched Zhuque-2, the world's first methane-liquid oxygen rocket to reach orbit, on 12 July 2023, ahead of US rivals (Starship, Vulcan, New Glenn).

src: APPSC Sample Taker 2023
s: After ____ years, mission operation for the joint NASA-JAXA Geotail spacecraft have ended in January 2023, after the failure of the spacecraft's remaining recorder.
x: Geotail, launched in July 1992 to study Earth's magnetosphere, ended after 30 years when its remaining data recorder failed (operations ended 28 Nov 2022; NASA announced it in Jan 2023).

src: Civils 2016
s: What is 'Greased Lightning-10 (GL-10)', that was recently in the news?
o: Solar-powered two-seater aircraft designed by Japan
x: Greased Lightning GL-10 was a battery-electric, 10-engine tilt-wing VTOL plane (drone) tested by NASA in 2015; it was not Japanese, Chinese or ISRO's.

src: TSPSC GWD 2023
s: Which nation launched the Shiyan-14 and Shiyan-15 experimental satellites?
x: Shiyan ('experiment') satellites are Chinese: Shiyan-14 and Shiyan-15 were launched on a Kuaizhou-1A from Taiyuan in September 2022.

src: TSPSC Junior Lecturers 2023
s: Which country developed MOXIE for human exploration of Mars?
x: MOXIE (Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment), which made oxygen from Martian CO2 on NASA's Perseverance rover, was developed by the USA (NASA/MIT).

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Hydrogeology) in AP Ground Water
s: To detect, .... US scientist have successfully launched a telescope named 'X-Calibur instrument'?
x: X-Calibur is a NASA balloon-borne instrument that measures the polarisation of X-rays from black holes and neutron stars.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s: Where was the 2nd AIIMS Oncology Conclave 2025 inaugurated?
x: Health Minister J.P. Nadda inaugurated the 2nd AIIMS Oncology Conclave (15 Feb 2025) at the National Cancer Institute, AIIMS Jhajjar (Haryana); AIIMS Delhi, Bhubaneswar and Bhopal were not the venue.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Which among the following acts as a nodal agency for sourcing of the Aarogya Maitri Cubes developed indigenously under e Project BHISHM?
x: HLL Lifecare Limited, a Health Ministry CPSE, is the nodal agency for sourcing the Aarogya Maitri (BHISHM) cubes – portable field hospitals made by several firms. IDPL and the two private firms are distractors.

src: APPSC Assistant Conservator of Forests General Studies & Men
s: Karnataka Chief Minister Basavaraj Bommai Launched a new health and wellness app AAYU to address and heal chronic diseases and lifestyle disorders through ____.
x:
Printed option and key: 'yoga and medication'. Strictly: AAYU works through yoga and meditation (theprint.in PTI report, 2022).
Karnataka CM Basavaraj Bommai launched AAYU (S-VYASA with RESET TECH, 2022) to heal chronic and lifestyle disorders through yoga and meditation; option (d) 'yoga and medication' is the printed key and a misprint of 'meditation'. Homeopathy and ayurveda are not part of it.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: The first ever Indian Brain Atlas (IBA 100) is developed by:
x: IIIT Hyderabad (Prof. Jayanthi Sivaswamy's team) built the first Indian Brain Atlas, IBA 100 (Oct 2019), from MRI scans of 100 adults. AIIMS, ISRO and ICAR are wrong.

src: AP recruitment paper (header page missing in scan)
s: Which research organisation is the first in the world to release detailed 3D high-resolution images of the foetal brain?
x: IIT Madras (Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre) released DHARANI, the world's first detailed 3D high-resolution images of the human foetal brain (Dec 2024). IIT Delhi, Kanpur and Bombay are wrong.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Researchers at ____ created the first-ever Indian Brain Atlas referred to as 'IBA 100' in October 2019.
o: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi (AIIMS)
International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIIT-H)
x: IIIT Hyderabad researchers created the first Indian Brain Atlas, IBA 100, in October 2019 (published in Neurology India). AIIMS, IISc and NBRC are wrong.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: The Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad's (IIT-H's) Centre for Healthcare Entrepreneurship (CHE) Fellow ____ has launched a 'vaccination on wheels clinic' in Pune in December 2019, in collaboration with the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.
x: Jignesh Patel, a fellow of IIT Hyderabad's Centre for Healthcare Entrepreneurship, launched the Vaccination on Wheels clinic in Pune in December 2019 with a Gates Foundation Grand Challenges grant.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Which of the following institutions launched India's first indigenously designed standing wheelchair called 'Arise'?
x: 'Arise', India's first indigenously designed standing wheelchair (Nov 2019), was developed by IIT Madras's TTK Centre for Rehabilitation Research and Device Development (R2D2). IIT Kharagpur, Bombay and Roorkee are wrong.

src: TSPSC Junior Lecturers 2023
s:
Which of the following Indian Institutes has a role in development of New Artificial light harvesting system?

I. IISER-Thiruvananthapuram

II. IIT-Indore
x: The artificial light-harvesting system with an atom-precise silver nanocluster (Chemical Science, 2022) was developed jointly by IISER Thiruvananthapuram (Sukhendu Mandal) and IIT Indore (Biswarup Pathak), so both I and II.

src: APPSC Assistant Chemist (AP Ground Water Service, AP Insuran
s: Which of the following was not one of the six themes of the three-day International Conference on "Ensemble Methods in Modelling and Data Assimilation (EMMDA)" that was organised by NCMRWF, MoES from February 24, 2020 at NCMRWF, Noida, India?
o: Ensemble methods in Global Weather Prediction
Ensemble methods in Monthly and Seasonal Forecasting
Ensemble method for data collection from networking sites for artificial weather regulation
x: EMMDA (NCMRWF, Noida, 24-26 Feb 2020) covered ensemble methods in global weather prediction, data assimilation, monthly and seasonal forecasting, convection-permitting systems, verification and applications; 'data collection from networking sites for artificial weather regulation' was not a theme.

src: TSPSC GWD 2023
s: In a test flight for cloud seeding in June 2023, which of these institutions successfully demonstrated the effectiveness of their 'artificial rain' technology?
o: The Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi
The Indian Institute of Technology, Mumbai
The Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur
The Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur
x: IIT Kanpur ran a cloud-seeding ('artificial rain') test flight on 22 June 2023 with a Cessna aircraft and DGCA approval; IIT Delhi, Bombay and Kharagpur are wrong.

src: APPSC Sample Taker 2023
s: In April 2023, which of the following institute developed a low-cost camera setup by collaborating with the NASA-Caltech from the US and Sweden's University of Gothenburg, which can provide multispectral imaging of four chemical species in a flame using single DSLR camera?
o: The Indian Institute of Technology, Indore
The International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore
The Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee
x: IIT Indore, with NASA-Caltech (JPL) and Sweden's University of Gothenburg, built the low-cost single-DSLR set-up (April 2023, ~Rs 50,000) that images four combustion species of a flame at once.

src: TREI-RB JL & DL & PGT (S3) 2023
s: RAKSHAK - A decision framework for Campus safety developed at IIT, Jodhpur in the context of COVID 19 is an abbreviation for
o: Remedial Action, Knowledge Skimming and Holistic Analysis
Rapid Action, Knowledge Skimming and Holistic Awakening
Remedial Action, Knowledge Sharing and Holistic Analysis
Rapid Action, Knowledge Sharing and Holistic Awakening
x: Campus RAKSHAK is IIT Jodhpur's COVID-19 decision framework (tapestry pooling, Go Corona Go app, simulators, Healthbadge) for safe reopening of campuses; the printed expansion 'Remedial Action, Knowledge Skimming and Holistic Analysis' is kept, as no official expansion was found.

src: TSPSC Junior Lecturers 2023
s: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras have launched an indigenously developed polycentric prosthetic knee, which aims to improve the quality of life for above-knee amputees. Which is the name given to it?
x: IIT Madras's R2D2 centre (with SBMT and Mobility India) launched 'Kadam', India's first indigenous polycentric prosthetic knee for above-knee amputees, on 8 April 2022.

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) & Technical Assistan
s: On 21, November, 2016, in which Scientific Organization, India became an associate member?
x: On 21 Nov 2016 India signed the agreement to become an Associate Member State of CERN (European Organization for Nuclear Research); NATO, ASTRONET and the World Future Society are wrong.

src: APPSC AEE Mains General Studies & Mental Ability 2016
s: In which one of the following cities the Bio-Asia Conference-2017 is to be held?
x: BioAsia 2017 (14th edition, 6-8 Feb 2017) was held at HICC, Hyderabad, its permanent venue.

src: APPSC Royalty Inspector, Agriculture Officer, Town Planning
s: In which University, the National Urdu Science Congress was held in February, 2017?
x: The third National Urdu Science Congress (16-17 Feb 2017) was held at Maulana Azad National Urdu University, Hyderabad; the 2016 edition was at Aligarh.

src: APPSC Animal Husbandry Department General Studies & Mental A
s: Which Country has started the World's deepest and largest underground laboratory for the global search for Dark matter?
x: China's Jinping Underground Laboratory (CJPL-II, Sichuan, operational Dec 2023), under 2,400 m of rock, is the world's deepest and largest underground lab, used for dark-matter searches (PandaX, CDEX); it overtook Italy's Gran Sasso.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Identify India's first indigenously developed CAR- T cell therapy for which Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) granted market approval
x: NexCAR19 (ImmunoACT, IIT Bombay, with Tata Memorial Centre) is India's first indigenous CAR-T cell therapy, approved by CDSCO in 2023 for B-cell cancers. Tecartus, Yescarta and Breyanzi are foreign CAR-T brands.

src: APPSC Group-I Prelims 2024 (17-03-2024)
s: Which among the following is the first country in the world to launch the Malaria vaccine for children into its routine national immunization services?
x: Cameroon (22 Jan 2024) was the first country to put a malaria vaccine (RTS,S) into routine child immunisation outside the Ghana-Kenya-Malawi pilot. Botswana, Cape Verde and DR Congo came later or not at all.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: In November 2019, ____ became the first country in the world to introduce the World Health Organization (WHO) recommended typhoid conjugate vaccine (TCV) into its national immunisation programme.
x: Pakistan became the first country to introduce the WHO-recommended typhoid conjugate vaccine into routine immunisation (campaign from 15 Nov 2019 in Sindh, amid an XDR typhoid outbreak).

src: APPSC Deputy Educational Officer Screening Test (General Stu
s: In April 2024, which of these countries became the first in world to introduce new 5-in-1 vaccine against meningitis?
x: In April 2024 WHO announced that Nigeria became the first country to roll out Men5CV (MenFive), a 5-in-1 conjugate vaccine against meningococcal serogroups A, C, W, Y and X, after a serogroup C outbreak. Kenya, Algeria and Sudan were not first.

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) & Technical Assistan
s: Which of the following is slated to be the platform for First Indian All Women Circumnavigation of the Globe expedition of the Indian Navy to be commenced in August, 2017?
x: INSV Tarini, a 56-ft sailing vessel, carried Navika Sagar Parikrama, the Indian Navy's first all-women circumnavigation (Sep 2017 – May 2018). INSV Mhadei is her sister ship used for earlier solo voyages.

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
s: Which country has developed the world's first deep-sea radar capable of detecting high-flying aircraft?
x: Chinese scientists claimed (reported Jan 2025) the world's first seabed 'radar' – an acoustic array at 1,000 m depth – that detected and tracked aircraft flying at 5,000 m. USA, Iraq and Russia are wrong.

src: AEE Mains 2016
s: Which country unveiled AG600, the world's largest aircraft which can land on both water and land
x: China's AVIC AG600 'Kunlong' is the world's largest amphibious aircraft, able to take off and land on water and land (unveiled July 2016).

src: APPSC Group-II Prelims 2024 (25-02-2024)
s: 'The Husavik Exploration Museum' seen in the news recently, belongs to which country?
x: The Exploration Museum at Husavik is in Iceland; it gave ISRO the 2023 Leif Erikson Lunar Prize for Chandrayaan-3's south-pole landing. Poland, Bulgaria and Saint Lucia have no link to it.

src: State PSC
s: What is the full form of GPT in ChatGPT, recently seen in the news?
x: GPT in ChatGPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer; ChatGPT was launched by OpenAI on 30 Nov 2022. The other expansions belong to an enzyme, a disk partition table and a dexterity test.
